GLA.source_paper: Signal estimation from modified short-time Fourier transform
GLA.rationale: Foundational unaccelerated baseline in phase retrieval (momentum-free, safe from overshoot).

FGLA_opt.algorithm: AGLA recurrence collapsed to 2 states with theoretical single-edge minimax momentum: alpha = beta = (1 - sqrt(1 - lambda_+^2)) / lambda_+, gamma = 1.0
FGLA_opt.parameters: Oracle-adaptive from local transverse eigenvalue lambda_+
FGLA_opt.rationale: Exact theoretical closed-form single-edge optimal fixed momentum.

NAGLA_H49_primary.source_paper: Accelerated Griffin-Lim Algorithm with Nesterov Momentum / Fast Phase Retrieval
NAGLA_H49_primary.citation: Nesterov (1983); Perraudin et al. (2013); 2026 NAGLA contemporary null-phase study.
NAGLA_H49_primary.selection_basis: Configuration used in the contemporary 2026 NAGLA literature in its principal null-phase comparative experiment; not selected on the GeoAGLA evaluation benchmark.

AGLA_TableII_primary.source_paper: Numerical Studies on Accelerated Griffin-Lim Algorithm
AGLA_TableII_primary.citation: Nenov et al., Table II leading configuration; Perraudin et al. (2013).
AGLA_TableII_primary.algorithm: t_n = (1 - gamma)*d_{n-1} + gamma*P_C1(P_C2(c_{n-1})), c_n = t_n + alpha*(t_n - t_{n-1}), d_n = t_n + beta*(t_n - t_{n-1})
AGLA_TableII_primary.selection_basis: Configuration with the largest reported average SSNR among Table-II combinations in Nenov et al.; genuine 3-state recurrence with non-trivial beta and gamma != 1.

Online_Full.source_paper: Geometry Determines Acceleration in Phase Retrieval (ICLR 2027)
Online_Full.algorithm: Ritz-adaptive momentum synthesis (p=3) with dynamic envelope damping and energy safeguard rollback to GLA
Online_Full.rationale: Strictly frozen configuration from Phase 2B / Phase 4 robustness protocol.

NAGLA_H2_sensitivity.selection_basis: Retained only as sensitivity evidence from Phase 4H-R; must not be used as primary published NAGLA headline.

FGLA_like_alpha099.selection_basis: Relabeled from old Phase 4H-R pseudo-AGLA run; gamma=1 collapses recurrence to FGLA dynamics.
